answers.1:
kubectl apply -n $NS -f - >/dev/null <<'EOF'
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: ca
spec:
  terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 0
  restartPolicy: Never
  containers:
  - name: c
    image: busybox:1.36
    command: ["echo"]
    args: ["hello", "k8s"]
EOF
sleep 8
kubectl logs ca -n $NS

# command 가 ENTRYPOINT, args 가 CMD 를 덮어쓴다. echo 가 끝나면 Pod 는 Succeeded
answers.2:
kubectl apply -n $NS -f - >/dev/null <<'EOF'
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: ev
spec:
  terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 0
  restartPolicy: Never
  containers:
  - name: c
    image: busybox:1.36
    env:
    - {name: GREETING, value: hi}
    command: ["echo"]
    args: ["$(GREETING) there"]
EOF
sleep 8
kubectl logs ev -n $NS

# $(GREETING) 은 쿠버네티스가 치환한다 (쉘 문법 ${GREETING} 이나 $GREETING 과 다르다)
answers.3:
kubectl apply -n $NS -f - >/dev/null <<'EOF'
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: wd
spec:
  terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 0
  restartPolicy: Never
  containers:
  - name: c
    image: busybox:1.36
    workingDir: /etc
    command: ["pwd"]
EOF
sleep 8
kubectl logs wd -n $NS

# workingDir 는 이미지의 WORKDIR 을 덮어쓴다
answers.4:
kubectl apply -n $NS -f - >/dev/null <<'EOF'
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: rn
spec:
  terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 0
  restartPolicy: Never
  containers:
  - name: c
    image: busybox:1.36
    command: ["sh", "-c", "exit 1"]
EOF
sleep 8
kubectl get pod rn -n $NS

# Never 면 실패한 컨테이너를 다시 띄우지 않는다. phase 는 Failed, RESTARTS 는 0
answers.5:
kubectl apply -n $NS -f - >/dev/null <<'EOF'
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: rf
spec:
  terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 0
  restartPolicy: OnFailure
  containers:
  - name: c
    image: busybox:1.36
    command: ["sh", "-c", "exit 1"]
EOF
sleep 45
kubectl get pod rf -n $NS

# OnFailure 는 실패하면 재시작, 성공(0)하면 끝. 재시작 간격은 점점 길어진다 (CrashLoopBackOff)
answers.6:
kubectl get pod crash -n $NS -o jsonpath='{.status.containerStatuses[0].lastState.terminated.exitCode}' > /tmp/q6.txt
cat /tmp/q6.txt

# state 는 지금, lastState 는 직전. 재시작 원인은 lastState 와 describe 의 Last State 에서 본다
answers.7:
kubectl delete pod $(cat /tmp/lab/orig.txt) -n $NS
kubectl rollout status deployment/heal -n $NS
kubectl get pods -l app=heal -n $NS

# 지운 Pod 와 이름이 다른 새 Pod 가 생겨 2개를 맞춘다. Pod 는 직접 지키지 않고 Deployment 가 지킨다
answers.8:
pod=$(cat /tmp/lab/orig.txt)
k1=$(kubectl get pod $pod -n $NS -o jsonpath='{.metadata.ownerReferences[0].kind}')
rs=$(kubectl get pod $pod -n $NS -o jsonpath='{.metadata.ownerReferences[0].name}')
k2=$(kubectl get rs $rs -n $NS -o jsonpath='{.metadata.ownerReferences[0].kind}')
echo "$k1 $k2" > /tmp/q8.txt
cat /tmp/q8.txt

# Pod → ReplicaSet → Deployment. 소유 관계가 있어서 Deployment 를 지우면 아래가 모두 지워진다
answers.9:
rs=$(kubectl get rs -l app=heal -n $NS -o name)
kubectl scale $rs -n $NS --replicas=5
sleep 5
kubectl get $rs -n $NS -o jsonpath='{.spec.replicas}' > /tmp/q9.txt
cat /tmp/q9.txt

# Deployment 컨트롤러가 ReplicaSet 의 replicas 를 Deployment 의 값(2)으로 되돌린다
